## Pipedrive → HubSpot Incremental Migration Pipeline

**Safe by default.** With no env vars this runs in **SANDBOX_MODE** on a synthetic Pipedrive fixture: zero network calls, nothing written, static data untouched. The validation report is in **Dry-Run Validation Report**.

Go-live is staged: `SANDBOX_MODE=false` (read-only extract + read-only HubSpot preflight, still DRY_RUN) → `DRY_RUN=false` + `HUBSPOT_WRITES_ENABLED=true` (idempotent batch upserts keyed by `pipedrive_*_id`).

Order: organizations → persons → deals → activities, then associations from Pipedrive foreign keys via the ID mapping tables. Fail closed on malformed pages, failed lookups, corrupt state and guard breaches. Tokens only via `$env`. See README.md.

nodes.name: Incremental Sync (hourly :17)
nodes.notes: Hourly incremental run at minute 17 (instance time zone). Ships inactive.

nodes.name: Config & Safety Gate
nodes.notes: Env-only config, fail-safe flags, host allowlists, owner / stage / activity mapping, guards.

nodes.name: Load Synthetic Pipedrive Fixture
nodes.notes: SANDBOX only: fictitious Pipedrive records, HubSpot snapshot and state seed.

nodes.name: Load Migration State
nodes.notes: Watermarks + ID mapping tables from static data; fail closed on corruption.

nodes.name: Pipedrive: Fetch Organizations
nodes.notes: Read-only Pipedrive v2 list of organizations updated since the watermark (cursor pagination, sorted by update_time). Any failure stops the run.

nodes.name: Collect Organization Pages
nodes.notes: Validates organizations pages; fails closed on malformed pages.

nodes.name: Pipedrive: Fetch Persons
nodes.notes: Read-only Pipedrive v2 list of persons updated since the watermark (cursor pagination, sorted by update_time). Any failure stops the run.

nodes.name: Collect Person Pages
nodes.notes: Validates persons pages; fails closed on malformed pages.

nodes.name: Pipedrive: Fetch Deals
nodes.notes: Read-only Pipedrive v2 list of deals updated since the watermark (cursor pagination, sorted by update_time). Any failure stops the run.

nodes.name: Collect Deal Pages
nodes.notes: Validates deals pages; fails closed on malformed pages.

nodes.name: Pipedrive: Fetch Activities
nodes.notes: Read-only Pipedrive v2 list of activities updated since the watermark (cursor pagination, sorted by update_time). Any failure stops the run.

nodes.name: Collect Activity Pages
nodes.notes: Validates activities pages; fails closed on malformed pages.

nodes.name: Normalize & Validate
nodes.notes: Pipedrive v2 → HubSpot payloads, validation issues, content hashes.

nodes.name: Build Preflight Lookups
nodes.notes: Read-only batch reads by unique property + contact emails.

nodes.name: Simulated HubSpot Lookup
nodes.notes: SANDBOX only: answers lookups from the fixture snapshot.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Preflight Batch Read
nodes.notes: Read-only batch read by unique property. Any failure stops the run (fail closed).

nodes.name: Migration Plan & Validation Report
nodes.notes: CREATE / UPDATE / SKIP_UNCHANGED / QUARANTINE, email conflicts, FK plan, guards, dry-run report.

nodes.name: Build Upsert Batches
nodes.notes: Batch upserts keyed by pipedrive_*_id (idempotent), dependency order.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Upsert
nodes.notes: Idempotent batch upsert / update. Retries are safe (upsert by unique property); failures are recorded per record.

nodes.name: Build Association Batches
nodes.notes: Resolves FK pairs through the mapping chain; unresolved pairs become pending.

nodes.name: HubSpot: Batch Associate
nodes.notes: v4 default associations (idempotent).

nodes.name: Commit Migration State
nodes.notes: Mapping tables, watermarks (held on failure), pending queue, quarantine registry.
